The '''Bundim Rebel Base''' was located in the [[Ghentiw Northern Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bundim]]. Following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Subjugation of Bundim|crackdown]] on the planet, and subsequent [[Battle of Heg]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces under the command of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Kray'geen T'ihar]] regrouped at the base.
